clarified_description: Adds a 'copy permalink' capability to each entry on the changelog page. Users can click a small, muted button located inline after the entry title to copy a URL containing a slugified anchor ID to their clipboard. The button provides immediate feedback by temporarily changing its label to 'Copied'.

constraints.detail: Must not introduce new external dependencies for the confirmation UI.

must: The system shall provide a button inline after the title of each changelog entry.
The system shall generate a slugified anchor ID from the entry title using lowercase letters and hyphens.
WHEN the copy button is clicked, the system shall copy the current page URL appended with the entry's anchor ID to the clipboard.
WHEN the copy button is clicked, the system shall change the button label to 'Copied' for approximately two seconds.
The system shall revert the button label to its original state (e.g., an icon or 'Link') after the two-second duration.
The system shall provide an accessible name for the copy button (e.g., via aria-label).
The system shall not modify the contents of `data/changelog.json` or the `/changelog.xml` route.
outcome: Users can share direct links to specific changelog updates via a single click.
rationale: The requirement for 'no new dependency' and 'no toast' dictates a local component state change for the button label. Using slugified titles for anchors is a standard way to provide deep-linking without requiring a database schema change for IDs.

risks.mitigation: If two entries have identical titles, they will share an anchor; however, for a changelog, chronological order usually prevents user confusion.
risks.title: Slug collision

should: The system shall use a muted visual style for the button to avoid distracting from the primary content.

criteria: Link includes a valid anchor ID
Confirmation is visible on the button itself
